widgets_values: A silver-haired explorer in a blue utility jacket.

FREE CHARACTER SHEET PLAN. The nine original Studixly templates produce a JSON shot plan. Seedance reference pack means three independent shots: front, three-quarter, side. Choose exactly one shot in the dropdown and turn On to output its single prompt/aspect. The JSON is a preview, not an automatically mapped prompt list. No Key, model call, guaranteed character consistency, or batch charges. To generate later, deliberately connect selected_prompt to an existing Image Submit/Edit and use model-supported parameters for selected_aspect. Reuse actual reference images for identity guidance. No shot is selected initially. Removing a selected sheet clears its selection; choose another shot explicitly.
